technical.summary: Strong bullish structure with golden cross and volume spike, but extreme overbought conditions on short timeframes and weak ADX trend strength create pullback risk; better suited for continuation entry on minor retracement than immediate swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ANET shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; elevated earnings volatility risk in 11 days with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal; mixed congressional activity from junior member with small amounts, neutral broad market sentiment, and unavailable news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Macro environment severely unfavourable: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (179.4) indicates extreme market stress, FOMC event just occurred, and earnings binary in 11 days compounds volatility risk despite falling USD being a minor tailwind for tech multinationals.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross + three white soldiers + 15x volume spike create textbook bullish structure with technical momentum, and price near support (31.46) offers defined risk entry for continuation trade.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme RSI 89.44 overbought, stoch 95.59 with no pullback, weak ADX 20.32 trend, zero fundamental conviction, high earnings risk in 11 days, and macro crisis (VIX 179.4, inverted yield curve) make this a momentum trap with severe downside risk.
